prompts.glass: Create a single premium urban mobile game menu glass surface, 2.2:1 aspect ratio. Orthographic front view, full panel visible with little external margin. Extremely thin polished silver perimeter with subtly chamfered corners, integrated small silvery lip on the lower edge, softly reflective smoky blue glass interior with subtle real glass grain. The glass interior MUST be genuinely partially transparent alpha, not opaque gray and not a painted checkerboard; center alpha roughly 10-22 percent, edges stronger. No scene or objects visible baked into it. Transparent outer background. No text, numbers, logos or symbols. Sophisticated contemporary Seoul headquarters design, no bolts, no thick metal box, no UI vector look. Frame, inner glass reflection and shadow must be one finished bitmap material. The upper left has a restrained optical silver reflection, center stays largely clear to see a scene underneath.
